(A) not less than 3.
(B) not less than 3 and not greater than 35.
(C) not greater than 35.
(D) equal to 35.
(E) equal to 3 or 35.
(7th American High School Mathematics Examination, 1956) -/
theorem algebra_233018 (p : ℕ) (hp : p > 0) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, 0 < k ∧ k = (3 * p + 25) / (2 * p - 5) ↔
    (3 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 35) := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_233018 (p : ℕ) (hp : p > 0) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, 0 < k ∧ k = (3 * p + 25) / (2 * p - 5) ↔
    (3 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 35) := by 
  by_cases h1 : 3 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 35
  · -- Assume (3 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 35)
    use (3 * p + 25) / (2 * p - 5)
    have h4 : 2 * p - 5 ≥ 1 := by 
      omega
    have h5 : (3 * p + 25) / (2 * p - 5) > 0 := by
      have h7 : 3 * p + 25 ≥ 34 := by 
        omega
      have h8 : 2 * p - 5 ≥ 1 := by 
        omega
      apply Nat.div_pos
      all_goals 
        omega
    constructor
    · -- Forward direction: (k > 0 ∧ k = ... ) → (3 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 35)
      intro h
      tauto
    · -- Backward direction: (3 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 35) → (k > 0 ∧ k = ... )
      intro h
      constructor
      · -- k > 0
        exact h5
      · -- k = (3 * p + 25) / (2 * p - 5)
        rfl
  · -- Assume ¬ (3 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 35)
    use 0
    simp at h1 ⊢
    all_goals 
      omega

theorem inequalities_33494 (a b c : ℝ) (h₀ : a + b + c = 2) (h₁ : a^2 + b^2 + c^2 = 2) :

formal_proof:

theorem inequalities_33494 (a b c : ℝ) (h₀ : a + b + c = 2) (h₁ : a^2 + b^2 + c^2 = 2) :
    |a - b| ≥ 1 ∨ |b - c| ≥ 1 ∨ |c - a| ≥ 1 := by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have h2 : |a - b| < 1 := by
    linarith [h.1]
  have h3 : |b - c| < 1 := by
    linarith [h.2.1]

/- B1. Find all real numbers $x$ that satisfy the equation

$$
6^{\log _{10} x}+x^{\log _{10} 6}=72
$$ -/
theorem algebra_134451 (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) :
    6 ^ Real.logb 10 x + x ^ Real.logb 10 6 = 72 ↔ x = 100 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_134451 (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) :
    6 ^ Real.logb 10 x + x ^ Real.logb 10 6 = 72 ↔ x = 100 := by
  constructor
  · -- Assume 6 ^ Real.logb 10 x + x ^ Real.logb 10 6 = 72. Prove x = 100
    intro h
    have h1 : 6 ^ Real.logb 10 x + x ^ Real.logb 10 6 = 72 := h
    have h2 : (x : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 6 = (6 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 x := by
      have h_eq1 : Real.logb 10 (x ^ Real.logb 10 6) = Real.logb 10 (6 ^ Real.logb 10 x) := by
        have h4 : Real.logb 10 (x ^ Real.logb 10 6) = Real.logb 10 6 * Real.logb 10 x := by
          rw [Real.logb_rpow_eq_mul_logb_of_pos]
          all_goals linarith
        have h5 : Real.logb 10 (6 ^ Real.logb 10 x) = Real.logb 10 x * Real.logb 10 6 := by
          rw [Real.logb_rpow_eq_mul_logb_of_pos]
          all_goals linarith
        rw [h4, h5]
        all_goals nlinarith
      have h3 : x ^ Real.logb 10 6 > 0 := by positivity
      have h4 : (6 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 x > 0 := by positivity
      have h7 : Real.logb 10 (x ^ Real.logb 10 6) = Real.logb 10 (6 ^ Real.logb 10 x) := h_eq1
      have h8 : x ^ Real.logb 10 6 = (6 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 x := by
        apply Real.logb_injOn_pos (by norm_num) (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr h3) (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr h4) h7
      exact_mod_cast h8
    rw [h2] at h1
    have h_eq3 : (6 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 x = 36 := by
      nlinarith
    have h_eq4 : Real.logb 10 (6 ^ Real.logb 10 x) = Real.logb 10 (36 : ℝ) := by
      rw [h_eq3]
    have h_eq7 : Real.logb 10 (6 ^ Real.logb 10 x) = Real.logb 10 x * Real.logb 10 6 := by
      rw [Real.logb_rpow_eq_mul_logb_of_pos]
      all_goals norm_num
      all_goals linarith
    have h_eq8 : Real.logb 10 (36 : ℝ) = 2 * Real.logb 10 6 := by
      calc
        Real.logb 10 (36 : ℝ) = Real.logb 10 (6 ^ 2) := by norm_num
        _ = 2 * Real.logb 10 6 := by
          simp [Real.logb_pow]
          <;> nlinarith
    rw [h_eq7] at h_eq4
    have h_eq9 : Real.logb 10 6 > (0 : ℝ) := by
      have h10 : Real.logb 10 6 > (0 : ℝ) := by
        apply Real.logb_pos
        all_goals norm_num
      linarith
    have h_eq10 : Real.logb 10 x = (2 : ℝ) := by
      have h_eq11 : Real.logb 10 x * Real.logb 10 6 = 2 * Real.logb 10 6 := by
        nlinarith [h_eq4, h_eq8]
      have h_eq12 : Real.logb 10 6 ≠ 0 := by
        nlinarith [h_eq9]
      have h_eq13 : Real.logb 10 x = 2 := by
        apply (mul_left_inj' h_eq12).mp
        linarith
      exact_mod_cast h_eq13
    have h_eq11 : x = (10 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.logb_eq_iff_rpow_eq] at h_eq10
      all_goals
        try norm_num at h_eq10 ⊢
        all_goals
          try nlinarith
          all_goals
            norm_num at h_eq10 ⊢
    have h_eq12 : x = 100 := by
      have h_eq13 : x = (10 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℝ) := h_eq11
      rw [h_eq13]
      norm_num
    linarith
  · -- Assume x = 100, prove the equation
    intro h
    rw [h]
    have h1 : Real.logb 10 (100 : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.logb_eq_iff_rpow_eq] <;> norm_num
    have h2 : (6 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 (100 : ℝ) = 36 := by
      rw [h1]
      have h3 : (6 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℝ) = (36 : ℝ) := by
        norm_num
      linarith
    have h3 : (100 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 (6 : ℝ) = (6 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℝ) := by
      have h4 : (100 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 (6 : ℝ) = (6 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 (100 : ℝ) := by
        have h5 : Real.logb 10 ((100 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 (6 : ℝ)) = Real.logb 10 ((6 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 (100 : ℝ)) := by
          have h6 : Real.logb 10 ((100 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 (6 : ℝ)) = Real.logb 10 (6 : ℝ) * Real.logb 10 (100 : ℝ) := by
            rw [Real.logb_rpow_eq_mul_logb_of_pos]
            all_goals norm_num
          have h7 : Real.logb 10 ((6 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 (100 : ℝ)) = Real.logb 10 (100 : ℝ) * Real.logb 10 (6 : ℝ) := by
            rw [Real.logb_rpow_eq_mul_logb_of_pos]
            all_goals norm_num
          rw [h6, h7]
          <;> try nlinarith
          all_goals
            linarith
        have h3 : (100 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 (6 : ℝ) > 0 := by positivity
        have h4 : (6 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 (100 : ℝ) > 0 := by positivity
        have h5' : Real.logb 10 ((100 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 (6 : ℝ)) = Real.logb 10 ((6 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 (100 : ℝ)) := h5
        have h6 : (100 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 (6 : ℝ) = (6 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 (100 : ℝ) := by
          apply Real.logb_injOn_pos (by norm_num) (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr h3) (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr h4) h5'
        exact_mod_cast h6
      rw [h4, h1]
      <;> norm_num
      <;> nlinarith
    have h4 : (6 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 (100 : ℝ) = 36 := h2
    have h5 : (100 : ℝ) ^ Real.logb 10 (6 : ℝ) = 36 := by
      rw [h3]
      all_goals norm_num
      <;> norm_num
      <;> nlinarith
    linarith

theorem algebra_604130 {x y : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hx : x = (1 + 1 / n) ^ n)

theorem algebra_604130 {x y : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hx : x = (1 + 1 / n) ^ n)
    (hy : y = (1 + 1 / n) ^ (n + 1)) : y ^ x = x ^ y := by 
  rw [hx, hy]
  have h1 : ((1 + (1 / (n : ℝ))) ^ (n + 1 : ℕ)) ^ ((1 + (1 / (n : ℝ))) ^ (n : ℕ) : ℝ) =
      (1 + (1 / (n : ℝ)) : ℝ) ^ ((n + 1 : ℝ) * ((1 + (1 / (n : ℝ))) ^ (n : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul]
    norm_cast
    all_goals positivity
  have h2 : ((1 + (1 / (n : ℝ))) ^ (n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((1 + (1 / (n : ℝ))) ^ (n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) =
      (1 + (1 / (n : ℝ)) : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ) * ((1 + (1 / (n : ℝ))) ^ (n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul]
    norm_cast
    all_goals positivity
  have h3 : (n + 1 : ℝ) * ((1 + (1 / (n : ℝ))) ^ (n : ℕ) : ℝ) =
      (n : ℝ) * ((1 + (1 / (n : ℝ))) ^ (n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by

      <;> ring
    rw [h4]
    field_simp at *
    <;> ring_nf
  rw [h1, h2]
  rw [h3]
  all_goals norm_num
  all_goals positivity
  all_goals norm_cast
  all_goals tauto

theorem inequalities_597368 (a b c d p q : ℝ)
    (h₀ : a * b + c * d = 2 * p * q)
    (h₁ : a * c ≥ p ^ 2)

  have h3 : (a * b + c * d) ^ 2 ≥ 4 * (a * c) * (b * d) := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a * b - c * d), sq_nonneg (a * d - b * c), sq_nonneg (a * c - b * d), sq_nonneg (a - c), sq_nonneg (b - d), sq_nonneg (a * b - c * d), sq_nonneg (a * d + b * c), sq_nonneg (a * c - b * d)]

  have h4 : (a * b + c * d) ^ 2 = 4 * (p * q) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      (a * b + c * d) ^ 2 = (2 * p * q) ^ 2 := by rw [h₀]
      _ = 4 * (p * q) ^ 2 := by ring

  have h5 : 4 * (p * q) ^ 2 ≥ 4 * (a * c) * (b * d) := by
    nlinarith [h3, h4]

      nlinarith [h7]

theorem number_theory_291312 {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, f (Real.cos x) = Real.cos (17 * x)) :

  intro x
  have h1 : f (Real.cos x) = Real.cos (17 * x) := hf x
  have h2 : f (Real.sin x) = Real.cos (17 * (Real.pi / 2 - x)) := by
    have h3 : Real.sin x = Real.cos (Real.pi / 2 - x) := by

    rw [h3]
    apply hf

  have h3 : Real.cos (17 * (Real.pi / 2 - x)) = Real.sin (17 * x) := by
    have h4 : 17 * (Real.pi / 2 - x) = 17 * (Real.pi / 2) - 17 * x := by
      ring
    rw [h4]
    have h5 : Real.cos (17 * (Real.pi / 2) - 17 * x) = Real.cos (17 * (Real.pi / 2)) * Real.cos (17 * x) + Real.sin (17 * (Real.pi / 2)) * Real.sin (17 * x) := by
      rw [Real.cos_sub]

    -- Real.cos (17 * (Real.pi / 2)) = 0

      have h7 : 17 * (Real.pi / 2) = 8 * Real.pi + Real.pi / 2 := by

        rw [h9]
        have h11 : Real.cos (Real.pi / 2 + 4 * (2 * Real.pi)) = Real.cos (Real.pi / 2) := by
          have h14 : Real.pi / 2 + 4 * (2 * Real.pi) = Real.pi / 2 + (4 : ℕ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
            rfl 
          rw [h14]
          rw [Real.cos_add_nat_mul_two_pi]
        exact h11
      rw [h8]
      norm_num
    -- Real.sin (17 * (Real.pi / 2)) = 1
    have h7 : Real.sin (17 * (Real.pi / 2)) = 1 := by 
      have h8 : 17 * (Real.pi / 2) = 8 * Real.pi + Real.pi / 2 := by 
        linarith [Real.pi_pos]

formal_proof:

theorem algebra_153218 (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (d t : ℝ) (ht : t > 0) (hd : d > 0) (h : d / (2 * a) = t / (2 * b)) :
    (d / (2 * a) + t / (2 * b)) < (d / (2 * b) + t / (2 * a)) := by
  have h1 : d * b = t * a := by
    field_simp [show (2 * a : ℝ) ≠ 0 by positivity, show (2 * b : ℝ) ≠ 0 by positivity] at h ⊢
    nlinarith
  have h3 : (d - t) * (1 / (2 * a) - 1 / (2 * b)) < 0 := by
    have h4 : (d - t) * (1 / (2 * a) - 1 / (2 * b)) = - (t * (a - b) ^ 2) / (2 * a * b ^ 2) := by
      have h5 : d = (t * a ) / b := by
        have h6 : d * b = t * a := h1
        field_simp [show (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith] at h6 ⊢
        nlinarith
      rw [h5]
      field_simp [show (a : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith, show (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [show (a : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith, show (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> nlinarith
    rw [h4]
    have h5 : t * (a - b) ^ 2 > 0 := by
      have h6 : (a - b) ^ 2 > 0 := by
        apply pow_two_pos_of_ne_zero
        intro h'
        apply hab
        linarith
      nlinarith
      all_goals nlinarith
    have h7 : - (t * (a - b) ^ 2) / (2 * a * b ^ 2) < 0 := by
      apply div_neg_of_neg_of_pos
      · -- Show negative numerator
        nlinarith
      · -- Show positive denominator
        positivity
    linarith
  have h4 : (d - t) * (1 / (2 * a) - 1 / (2 * b)) = (d / (2 * a) + t / (2 * b)) - (d / (2 * b) + t / (2 * a)) := by
    field_simp [show (a : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith, show (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> field_simp [show (a : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith, show (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> nlinarith
  have h5 : (d / (2 * a) + t / (2 * b)) - (d / (2 * b) + t / (2 * a)) < 0 := by
    linarith [h3, h4]

theorem algebra_197724 {f : ℤ → ℤ} (hf0 : f 0 = 1) (hfx : ∀ x, f (x + 3) = f x + 2 * x + 3) :
    f 6000 = 12000001 := by
formal_proof:

theorem algebra_197724 {f : ℤ → ℤ} (hf0 : f 0 = 1) (hfx : ∀ x, f (x + 3) = f x + 2 * x + 3) :
    f 6000 = 12000001 := by
  have h1 : ∀ (n : ℕ), f (3 * (n : ℤ)) = 1 + 3 * ((n : ℤ) ) ^ 2 := by
    intro n 
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      norm_num [hf0]
    | succ n ih =>
      have eq1 : f (3 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ) = f (3 * ((n : ℕ) : ℤ) + 3 ) := by
        simp at *
        <;> ring_nf
      rw [eq1]
      rw [show 3 * ((n : ℕ) : ℤ) + 3 = (3 * ((n : ℕ) : ℤ) ) + 3 by ring]
      rw [hfx]
      rw [ih]
      simp [pow_two]
      <;> ring_nf
  have h2 : f 6000 = 1 + 3 * ((2000 : ℤ) ) ^ 2 := by
    specialize h1 2000
    norm_num at h1 ⊢
    linarith
  rw [h2]
  norm_num

    (han : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = a n ^ 3 - a n + 1) :

formal_proof:

theorem inequalities_599672 (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (h1 : a < 1) (h2 : b < 1) :
    a / (1 - a ^ 2) + b / (1 - b ^ 2) ≥ (a + b) / (1 - a * b) := by
  have h3 : 0 < 1 - a ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith
  have h4 : 0 < 1 - b ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith
  have h5 : 0 < 1 - a * b := by
    nlinarith
  have h6 : 0 < (1 - a ^ 2) * (1 - b ^ 2) * (1 - a * b) := by
    positivity

  have h7 : a / (1 - a ^ 2) + b / (1 - b ^ 2) - (a + b) / (1 - a * b) ≥ 0 := by
    have h8 : a / (1 - a ^ 2) + b / (1 - b ^ 2) - (a + b) / (1 - a * b) =
        ( (a * (1 - b ^ 2) * (1 - a * b) + b * (1 - a ^ 2) * (1 - a * b) - (a + b) * (1 - a ^ 2) * (1 - b ^ 2) ) / ( (1 - a ^ 2) * (1 - b ^ 2) * (1 - a * b) ) ) := by
      field_simp [(show 1 - a ^ 2 ≠ 0 by nlinarith), (show 1 - b ^ 2 ≠ 0 by nlinarith), (show 1 - a * b ≠ 0 by nlinarith)]
      <;> ring
      <;> field_simp [(show 1 - a ^ 2 ≠ 0 by nlinarith), (show 1 - b ^ 2 ≠ 0 by nlinarith), (show 1 - a * b ≠ 0 by nlinarith)]
      <;> ring
      <;> field_simp [(show 1 - a ^ 2 ≠ 0 by nlinarith), (show 1 - b ^ 2 ≠ 0 by nlinarith), (show 1 - a * b ≠ 0 by nlinarith)]
    rw [h8]

    have h9 : ( a * (1 - b ^ 2) * (1 - a * b) + b * (1 - a ^ 2) * (1 - a * b) - (a + b) * (1 - a ^ 2) * (1 - b ^ 2) ) ≥ 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (a * b - a * b), sq_nonneg (a * b - a * b), sq_nonneg (a * b - 0), sq_nonneg ((a - b) * (a * b)), 
        mul_pos ha hb, mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr h1) (sub_pos.mpr h2), 
        mul_pos ha (sub_pos.mpr h2), 
        mul_pos hb (sub_pos.mpr h1), 
        mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr h1) (sub_pos.mpr h2)]
    
    apply div_nonneg
    linarith
    positivity
  
  linarith

formal_proof:

theorem algebra_11125 (x : ℝ) :
    2 * ⌊2 * x - 1⌋ ^ 2 + ⌊2 * x - 1⌋ - 1 = 0 ↔ x ∈ Set.Ico 0 (1 / 2) := by
  constructor
  · -- Assume 2 * ⌊2 * x - 1⌋ ^ 2 + ⌊2 * x - 1⌋ - 1 = 0, prove x ∈ Set.Ico 0 (1 / 2)
    intro h
    have h1 : ⌊2 * x - 1⌋ = -1 := by
      have h_eq : 2 * ⌊2 * x - 1⌋ ^ 2 + ⌊2 * x - 1⌋ - 1 = 0 := h
      have h4 : ⌊2 * x - 1⌋ = -1 := by
        ring_nf at h_eq
        have h5 : ⌊2 * x - 1⌋ ≤ 0 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg ( ⌊2 * x - 1⌋ : ℤ ) ]
        have h7 : ⌊2 * x - 1⌋ ≥ -1 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg ( ⌊2 * x - 1⌋ : ℤ ) ]
        interval_cases ( ⌊2 * x - 1⌋ : ℤ ) <;> try { tauto }
      exact h4
    have h2 : (⌊2 * x - 1⌋ : ℝ) = -1 := by
      exact_mod_cast h1
    have h3 : -1 ≤ 2 * x - 1 := by
      have h4 : (⌊2 * x - 1⌋ : ℝ) ≤ 2 * x - 1 := by
        exact Int.floor_le (2 * x - 1)
      rw [h2] at h4
      linarith
    have h4 : 2 * x - 1 < 0 := by
      have h5 : (2 * x - 1) < (⌊2 * x - 1⌋ + 1 : ℝ) := by
        exact Int.lt_floor_add_one (2 * x - 1)
      rw [h2] at h5
      linarith
    constructor
    · -- Show x ≥ 0
      nlinarith
    · -- Show x < 1 / 2
      nlinarith
  · -- Assume x ∈ Set.Ico 0 (1 / 2), prove 2 * ⌊2 * x - 1⌋ ^ 2 + ⌊2 * x - 1⌋ - 1 = 0
    rintro (⟨hx1, hx2⟩)
    have h1 : ⌊2 * x - 1⌋ = -1 := by
      have h2 : -1 ≤ 2 * x - 1 := by
        linarith
      have h3 : 2 * x - 1 < 0 := by
        linarith
      rw [Int.floor_eq_iff]
      constructor <;> (try norm_num) <;> try linarith
    rw [h1]
    all_goals norm_num

theorem number_theory_265421 (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h1 : (p + 28).Prime) (h2 : (p + 56).Prime) :

formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem number_theory_265421 (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h1 : (p + 28).Prime) (h2 : (p + 56).Prime) :
    p = 3 := by
  by_cases h : p ≤ 59
  · interval_cases p <;> norm_num at hp h1 h2 ⊢ <;> tauto
  · -- Assume p > 59
    push_neg at h
    have h3 : p % 3 = 0 ∨ p % 3 = 1 ∨ p % 3 = 2 := by
      omega
    rcases h3 with (h3 | h3 | h3)
    · -- Assume p % 3 = 0
      have h4 : p % 3 = 0 := by
        omega
      have h5 : p > 3 := by
        omega
      have h6 : ¬p.Prime := by
        apply Nat.not_prime_of_dvd_of_lt (show 3 ∣ p by omega)
        all_goals omega
      contradiction
    · -- Assume p % 3 = 1
      have h7 : p % 3 = 1 := by
        omega
      have h8 : (p + 56) % 3 = 0 := by
        omega
      have h9 : ¬(p + 56).Prime := by
        apply Nat.not_prime_of_dvd_of_lt (show 3 ∣ (p + 56) by omega)
        all_goals omega

    · -- Assume p % 3 = 2

        omega
      have h11 : (p + 28) % 3 = 0 := by
        omega
      have h12 : ¬(p + 28).Prime := by

/- Eva thought of two natural numbers. She first correctly added the numbers, then subtracted them. In both cases, she got a two-digit result. The product of the two-digit numbers thus created was 645.

Which numbers did Eva think of?

Hint. Every natural number has a finite number of divisors. -/
theorem number_theory_279550 (a b : ℕ) (ha : a > 0) (hb : b > 0)
    (h1 : (a + b) ∈ Finset.Icc 10 99) (h2 : (a - b) ∈ Finset.Icc 10 99)
    (h3 : (a + b) * (a - b) = 645) :

formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem number_theory_279550 (a b : ℕ) (ha : a > 0) (hb : b > 0)
    (h1 : (a + b) ∈ Finset.Icc 10 99) (h2 : (a - b) ∈ Finset.Icc 10 99)

/- 9.095. $\log _{4}(x+7)>\log _{2}(x+1)$. -/
theorem inequalities_190303 (x : ℝ) (hx : x > -1) : logb 4 (x + 7) > logb 2 (x + 1) ↔ x ∈ Set.Ioo (-1) 2 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Real

theorem inequalities_190303 (x : ℝ) (hx : x > -1) : logb 4 (x + 7) > logb 2 (x + 1) ↔ x ∈ Set.Ioo (-1) 2 := by
  constructor
  · -- Prove the forward direction: if $\log_{4}(x+7) > \log_{2}(x+1)$, then $x \in (-1, 2)$
    intro h
    have h1 : logb 4 (x + 7) = (logb 2 (x + 7)) / 2 := by
      have h2 : logb 4 (x + 7) = logb 2 (x + 7) / logb 2 (4 : ℝ) := by 
        field_simp [logb]
        all_goals linarith
      have h3 : logb 2 (4 : ℝ) = 2 := by 
        rw [Real.logb_eq_iff_rpow_eq] <;> (norm_num)
      rw [h2, h3]
    rw [h1] at h
    have h2 : logb 2 (x + 7) > 2 * logb 2 (x + 1) := by 
      linarith 
    -- Now convert $\log_2(x + 7) > 2 \cdot \log_2(x + 1)$ to the original form:
    have h3 : logb 2 (x + 7) > logb 2 ((x + 1) ^ 2) := by 
      have h4 : logb 2 ((x + 1) ^ 2) = 2 * logb 2 (x + 1) := by 
        simp [logb_pow]
      rw [h4] 
      linarith 
    -- Since logarithm base 2 is strictly increasing, this implies $x + 7 > (x + 1) ^2$.
    have h4 : x + 7 > (x + 1) ^ 2 := by
      by_contra h7
      push_neg at h7 
      have h8 : (x + 1) ^ 2 ≥ x + 7 := by linarith 
      have h9 : logb 2 ((x + 1) ^ 2) ≥ logb 2 (x + 7) := by 
        apply Real.logb_le_logb_of_le 
        all_goals 
          nlinarith 
      linarith 
    have h5 : (x + 1) ^ 2 < x + 7 := by linarith 
    -- Solving $x^2 + x - 6 < 0$ gives $-3 < x < 2$. Combined with the domain $x > -1$ we get $-1 < x < 2$
    have h6 : x ^ 2 + x - 6 < 0 := by 
      nlinarith 
    have h7 : x < 2 := by 
      nlinarith 
    exact ⟨hx, h7⟩ 
  · -- Prove the reverse direction: if $x \in (-1, 2)$, then $\log_{4}(x+7) > \log_{2}(x+1)$
    rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ 
    have h1' : logb 4 (x + 7) = (logb 2 (x + 7)) / 2 := by
      have h2 : logb 4 (x + 7) = logb 2 (x + 7) / logb 2 (4 : ℝ) := by 
        field_simp [logb]
        all_goals linarith 
      have h3 : logb 2 (4 : ℝ) = 2 := by 
        rw [Real.logb_eq_iff_rpow_eq] <;> norm_num 
      rw [h2, h3]
    have h2 : logb 2 (x + 7) > 2 * logb 2 (x + 1) := by 
      have h3 : x + 7 > (x + 1) ^ 2 := by 
        nlinarith 
      have h4 : logb 2 (x + 7) > logb 2 ((x + 1) ^ 2) := by 
        apply Real.logb_lt_logb 
        all_goals 
          nlinarith
      have h5 : logb 2 ((x + 1) ^ 2) = 2 * logb 2 (x + 1) := by 
        simp [logb_pow]
      linarith [h4, h5]
    have h3 : logb 4 (x + 7) > logb 2 (x + 1) := by 
      rw [h1']
      linarith 
    linarith

/- 1. Prove: For any positive integer $n, 3^{n}+2 \times 17^{n}$ is not a multiple of 5, and find the smallest positive integer $n$, such that
$$
11 \mid\left(3^{n}+2 \times 17^{n}\right) .
$$ -/
theorem number_theory_315934 :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ¬ 5 ∣ 3^n + 2 * 17^n) ∧
    IsLeast {n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ 11 ∣ 3^n + 2 * 17^n} 4 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem number_theory_315934 :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ¬ 5 ∣ 3^n + 2 * 17^n) ∧
    IsLeast {n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ 11 ∣ 3^n + 2 * 17^n} 4 := by 
  constructor 
  · -- Prove: For any positive integer n, 3^n + 2 × 17^n is not a multiple of 5 
    intro n hn
    have h1 : (3^n + 2 * 17^n) % 5 = 2 ∨ (3^n + 2 * 17^n) % 5 = 3 := by
      have h2 : ∀ n : ℕ, (3^n + 2 * 17^n) % 5 = 2 ∨ (3^n + 2 * 17^n) % 5 = 3 := by
        intro n 
        induction' n using Nat.strongRecOn with n ih 
        cases n with 
        | zero => 
          simp 
        | succ n => 
          cases n with 
          | zero => 
            norm_num 
          | succ n => 
            have h3 := ih (n) (by omega) 
            simp [Nat.pow_succ, show 17 % 5 = 2 by norm_num, show 3 % 5 = 3 by norm_num] at h3 ⊢ 
            omega 
      specialize h2 n 
      simpa using h2
    have h2 : ¬ 5 ∣ 3 ^ n + 2 * 17 ^ n := by 
      have h3 : (3 ^ n + 2 * 17 ^ n) % 5 = 2 ∨ (3 ^ n + 2 * 17 ^ n) % 5 = 3 := h1 
      omega 
    exact h2
  · -- Prove: 4 is the least positive integer that satisfies $3^n + 2 \cdot 17^n$ divisible by 11.
    constructor
    · -- Show 4 is in the set.
      constructor
      · -- Show 4 is positive.
        norm_num 
      · -- Show 11 divides $3^4 + 2 \cdot 17^4$.
        norm_num 
    · -- Show 4 is the least.
      intro n hn
      rcases hn with ⟨hn_pos, hn_div⟩ 
      by_contra h 
      push_neg at h 
      have h6 : n < 4 := by linarith 
      interval_cases n <;> norm_num at hn_div

    (h1 : x1^2 + a * x2^2 = b)
    (h2 : x2 * y1 - x1 * y2 = a)

theorem algebra_324441 (a b c : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0)

    (h2 : x2 * y1 - x1 * y2 = a)

    nlinarith

    field_simp [hb]
    linarith
  exact eq3

B:$\left[ -2,0 \right)$

C:$\left[ 0,2 \right)$

D:$\left[ 0,3 \right)$ -/
theorem algebra_11395 {a : ℝ} (A : Set ℝ) (hA : A = {x | -2 ≤ x ∧ x < 4}) (B : Set ℝ)

formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Set Real

theorem algebra_11395 {a : ℝ} (A : Set ℝ) (hA : A = {x | -2 ≤ x ∧ x < 4}) (B : Set ℝ)
    (hB : B = {x | x ^ 2 - a * x - 4 ≤ 0}) (hBA : B ⊆ A) :
    0 ≤ a ∧ a < 3 := by

  have h1 : ∀ x, x ^ 2 - a * x - 4 ≤ 0 → -2 ≤ x ∧ x < 4 := by
    intro x hx
    have hx_in_B : x ∈ B := by
      rw [hB]
      exact hx
    have hx_in_A : x ∈ A := by 
      apply hBA 
      exact hx_in_B
    rw [hA] at hx_in_A
    exact hx_in_A

  have h2 := h1 ((a + Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + 16)) / 2) (by 
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (a ^ 2 + 16), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ a ^ 2 + 16 by nlinarith)]
  )

  have h3 := h1 ((a - Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + 16)) / 2) (by
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (a ^ 2 + 16), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ a ^ 2 + 16 by nlinarith)]
  )

  have h4 : -2 ≤ (a + Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + 16)) / 2 := by
    linarith [h2.1]

  have h5 : (a + Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + 16)) / 2 < (4 : ℝ) := by
    linarith [h2.2]

  have h6 : -2 ≤ (a - Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + 16)) / 2 := by
    linarith [h3.1]

  have h7 : (a - Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + 16)) / 2 < (4 : ℝ) := by
    linarith [h3.2]

  have h8 : 0 ≤ a := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + 16) - (4 + a)), Real.sqrt_nonneg (a ^ 2 + 16), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ a ^ 2 + 16 by nlinarith)]

  have h9 : a < 3 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + 16) - (8 - a)), Real.sqrt_nonneg (a ^ 2 + 16), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ a ^ 2 + 16 by nlinarith)]

  constructor <;> linarith [h8, h9]

b) $\frac{2}{x}+\frac{1}{x^{2}}-\frac{7+10 x}{x^{2}\left(x^{2}+7\right)}=\frac{2}{x+\frac{3}{x+\frac{4}{x}}}$. -/
theorem algebra_260737_1 {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hx' : 8*x+3 ≠ 0) (hx'': 7*x-3 ≠ 0)
  : 2 + 5 / (4 * x) - 15 / (4 * x * (8 * x + 3)) = (2 * (7 * x + 1)) / (7 * x - 3) ↔ x = 9 := by
  constructor <;> rintro h
  . -- multiply all denominators and normalize to get a cubic equation
    field_simp at h
    ring_nf at h
    replace h : 96 * x^2 * (x - 9) = 0 := by linear_combination h
    -- due to x ≠ 0, we get x = 9 = 0
    simp [hx] at h
    linarith
    -- 9 is a root, prove by pluggin in
  . rw [h]
    norm_num

theorem algebra_260737_2 {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0)
  : 2 / x + 1 / x ^ 2 - (7 + 10 * x) / (x ^ 2 * (x ^ 2 + 7)) = 2 / (x + 3 / (x + 4 / x)) ↔ x = 4 := by
formal_proof:

theorem algebra_260737_1 {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hx' : 8*x+3 ≠ 0) (hx'': 7*x-3 ≠ 0)
  : 2 + 5 / (4 * x) - 15 / (4 * x * (8 * x + 3)) = (2 * (7 * x + 1)) / (7 * x - 3) ↔ x = 9 := by
  constructor <;> rintro h
  . -- multiply all denominators and normalize to get a cubic equation
    field_simp at h
    ring_nf at h
    replace h : 96 * x^2 * (x - 9) = 0 := by linear_combination h
    -- due to x ≠ 0, we get x = 9 = 0
    simp [hx] at h
    linarith
    -- 9 is a root, prove by pluggin in
  . rw [h]
    norm_num

theorem algebra_260737_2 {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0)
  : 2 / x + 1 / x ^ 2 - (7 + 10 * x) / (x ^ 2 * (x ^ 2 + 7)) = 2 / (x + 3 / (x + 4 / x)) ↔ x = 4 := by
  constructor
  · -- Assume left side, prove right side
    intro h
    -- simplify the right side.
    have h1 : x + 4 / x = (x ^ 2 + 4) / x := by field_simp; ring
    have h2 : (2 / (x + 3 / (x + 4 / x))) = 2 * (x ^ 2 + 4) / (x ^ 3 + 7 * x) := by
      rw [show x + 3 / (x + 4 / x) = (x ^ 3 + 7 * x) / (x ^ 2 + 4) by
        rw [show x + 4 / x = (x ^ 2 + 4) / x by field_simp; ring]
        field_simp
        <;> ring
        <;> field_simp
        <;> ring
      ]
      field_simp
      <;> ring
      <;> field_simp
      <;> ring
    rw [h2] at h
    have hx2_ne : x ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h1
      have : x = 0 := by
        nlinarith
      contradiction
    have hx2_add4_ne : x ^ 2 + 4 ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h1
      have h1' : x ^ 2 = -4 := by nlinarith
      have h2 : x ^ 2 ≥ 0 := sq_nonneg x
      nlinarith
    have h3 : x ^ 3 + 7 * x ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h1
      have h4 : x * (x ^ 2 + 7) = 0 := by
        nlinarith
      cases' (mul_eq_zero.mp h4) with h5 h6
      · -- x = 0 is impossible
        exfalso
        exact hx h5
      · -- x ^ 2 + 7 = 0 is impossible
        have : x ^ 2 = -7 := by nlinarith
        have h2 : x ^ 2 ≥ 0 := sq_nonneg x
        nlinarith
    field_simp at h
    ring_nf at h
    -- now `h` is a polynomial equation
    -- convert polynomial equation into factors 
    have h_zero : x ^ 5 * (x - 4) * (x ^ 2 + 7) = 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hx, sq_nonneg (x ^ 2 + 4), sq_nonneg (x ^ 3 + 7 * x),
        sq_nonneg (x ^ 2 - 16), sq_nonneg (x ^ 2 + 7), sq_nonneg (x - 4), sq_nonneg (x + 4)]
    cases' (mul_eq_zero.mp h_zero) with h1 h2
    · cases' (mul_eq_zero.mp h1) with h4 h5
      · -- we get x ^ 5 = 0 => x = 0 is impossible
        have h_zero_5 : x ^ 5 = 0 := by
          nlinarith
        have hx'1 : x = 0 := by
          have : x ^ 5 = 0 := h_zero_5
          simp at this
          linarith
        contradiction
      · -- we get x - 4 = 0 => x = 4
        linarith
    · -- we get x ^ 2 + 7 = 0 => impossible
      have h_zero_s2 : x ^ 2 + 7 = 0 := by
        nlinarith
      -- is_zero_s2 : x^2 = -7
      have hx'2 : x ^ 2 = -7 := by
        nlinarith
      -- contradicts by x^2 >= 0
      have hx'2_neg : x ^ 2 + 7 = 0 := h_zero_s2
      have h_non_pos : x ^ 2 >= 0 := sq_nonneg x
      nlinarith
  · -- Assume right side, prove left side
    intro h
    rw [h]
    norm_num
    <;> field_simp

    <;> norm_num

theorem algebra_70055 {x y z : ℝ} (h₀ : x = y^3 + y - 8) (h₁ : y = z^3 + z - 8)

formal_proof:

theorem algebra_70055 {x y z : ℝ} (h₀ : x = y^3 + y - 8) (h₁ : y = z^3 + z - 8)
    (h₂ : z = x^3 + x - 8) :
    (x, y, z) = (2, 2, 2) := by
  simp [Prod.ext_iff] at *
  have h_eq1 : x = 2 := by 
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x^2 - 4), sq_nonneg (y^2 - 4), sq_nonneg (z^2 - 4),
        sq_nonneg (x - 2), sq_nonneg (y - 2), sq_nonneg (z - 2), 
        h₀, h₁, h₂, 
        mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (x - 2)) (sq_nonneg (y - 2)), 
        mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (y - 2)) (sq_nonneg (z - 2)),

  have h_eq2 : y = 2 := by

theorem algebra_7598 {a b c : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} 
    (hf : ∀x, f x = a * x^2 + b * x + c) (ha : a ≠ 0) 
    (h1 : f 13 = 0) (h2 : f 3 = 0) (h3 : f 10 = 1.4) :
    f = fun x ↦ (-1/15) * x^2 + (16/15) * x + (-13/5) := by

  have eq2 : a * 3 ^ 2 + b * 3 + c = 0 := by

    linarith
  have eq3 : a * 10 ^ 2 + b * 10 + c = 1.4 := by

    linarith

    ring_nf at eq1 eq2 eq3

formal_proof:

theorem algebra_11723 : {x : ℂ | (x - 3) ^ 4 + (x - 5) ^ 4 = -8} =
    {4 + .I, 4 - .I, 4 + .I * (√5 : ℂ), 4 - .I * (√5 : ℂ)} := by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.union_insert, Set.union_singleton]
  constructor
  · -- First, prove that if $(x - 3)^4 + (x - 5)^4 = -8$, then $x \in \{4 \pm i, 4 \pm i\sqrt{5}\}$.
    intro h
    have h1 : (x - 3) ^ 4 + (x - 5) ^ 4 = -8 := h
    have eq1 : (x - 3) = (x - 4) + 1 := by ring_nf
    have eq2 : (x - 5) = (x - 4) - 1 := by ring_nf
    rw [eq1, eq2] at h1
    have eq3 : ((x - 4) + 1) ^ 4 + ((x - 4) - 1) ^ 4 + 8 = 0 := by
      calc
        ((x - 4) + 1) ^ 4 + ((x - 4) - 1) ^ 4 + 8 = (-8) + 8 := by rw [← h1]
        _ = 0 := by ring_nf
    have eq4 : ((x - 4) ^ 2 + 1) * ((x - 4) ^ 2 + 5) = 0 := by
      have eq5 : ((x - 4) + 1) ^ 4 + ((x - 4) - 1) ^ 4 + 8 = 0 := eq3
      ring_nf at eq5 ⊢
      norm_num [pow_two, pow_three, pow_succ, Complex.ext_iff, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im] at eq5 ⊢
      constructor
      · 
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 5, Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 5 by norm_num)]
      · 
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 5, Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 5 by norm_num)]
    cases' (mul_eq_zero.mp eq4) with h2 h3
    · -- First case: (x - 4) ^ 2 + 1 = 0
      have eq5 : (x - 4) ^ 2 + 1 = 0 := h2
      have eq6 : (x - 4) = Complex.I ∨ (x - 4) = -Complex.I := by
        have h1 : (x - 4) ^ 2 + 1 = 0 := eq5
        have h2 : (x - 4) ^ 2 = -1 := by
          calc
            (x - 4) ^ 2 = (x - 4) ^ 2 + 1 - 1 := by ring
            _ = -1 := by rw [h1]; ring
        have h3 : (x - 4) ^ 2 + 1 = 0 := h1
        have h4 : (x - 4) = Complex.I ∨ (x - 4) = -Complex.I := by
          have h5 : (x - 4) ^ 2 + 1 = 0 := h1
          have h6 : (x - 4) ^ 2 + 1 = (x - 4 - Complex.I) * (x - 4 + Complex.I) := by
            ring_nf
            simp [Complex.I_mul_I]
            ring
          rw [h6] at h5
          cases (mul_eq_zero.mp h5) with
          | inl h7 =>
            left
            calc
              x - 4 = (x - 4 - Complex.I) + Complex.I := by ring
              _ = Complex.I := by
                rw [h7]
                ring
          | inr h8 =>
            right
            calc
              x - 4 = (x - 4 + Complex.I) - Complex.I := by ring
              _ = -Complex.I := by
                rw [h8]
                ring
        assumption
      cases eq6 with
      | inl h7 =>
        have hx : x = 4 + Complex.I := by
          calc
            x = (x - 4) + 4 := by ring
            _ = Complex.I + 4 := by rw [h7]
            _ = 4 + Complex.I := by ring
        simp [hx]
      | inr h8 =>
        have hx : x = 4 - Complex.I := by
          calc
            x = (x - 4) + 4 := by ring
            _ = -Complex.I + 4 := by rw [h8]
            _ = 4 - Complex.I := by ring
        simp [hx]
    · -- Second case: (x - 4) ^ 2 + 5 = 0
      have eq7 : (x - 4) ^ 2 + 5 = 0 := h3
      have eq9 : (x - 4) = Complex.I * (√5 : ℂ) ∨ (x - 4) = -Complex.I * (√5 : ℂ) := by
        have h4 : (x - 4) ^ 2 + 5 = 0 := eq7
        have h5 : (x - 4) ^ 2 + 5 = (x - 4 - Complex.I * (√5 : ℂ)) * (x - 4 + Complex.I * (√5 : ℂ)) := by
          ring_nf
          simp [Complex.ext_iff, pow_two, mul_add, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Real.sqrt_mul_self]
          ring
        rw [h5] at h4
        cases (mul_eq_zero.mp h4) with
        | inl h6 =>
          left
          calc
            x - 4 = (x - 4 - Complex.I * (√5 : ℂ)) + Complex.I * (√5 : ℂ) := by ring
            _ = Complex.I * (√5 : ℂ) := by
              rw [h6]
              ring
        | inr h7 =>
          right
          calc
            x - 4 = (x - 4 + Complex.I * (√5 : ℂ)) - Complex.I * (√5 : ℂ) := by ring
            _ = -Complex.I * (√5 : ℂ) := by
              rw [h7]
              ring
      cases eq9 with
      | inl h10 =>
        have hx : x = 4 + Complex.I * (√5 : ℂ) := by
          calc
            x = (x - 4) + 4 := by ring
            _ = Complex.I * (√5 : ℂ) + 4 := by rw [h10]
            _ = 4 + Complex.I * (√5 : ℂ) := by ring
        simp [hx]
      | inr h11 =>
        have hx : x = 4 - Complex.I * (√5 : ℂ) := by
          calc
            x = (x - 4) + 4 := by ring
            _ = -Complex.I * (√5 : ℂ) + 4 := by rw [h11]
            _ = 4 - Complex.I * (√5 : ℂ) := by ring
        simp [hx]
  · -- Now prove the reverse: each root satisfies the equation.
    rintro (h | h | h | h)
    · -- First case: x = 4 + i

      norm_num [pow_two, pow_three, pow_succ, Complex.ext_iff, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    · -- Second case: x = 4 - i

      norm_num [pow_two, pow_three, pow_succ, Complex.ext_iff, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]

      simp [pow_two, pow_three, pow_succ, Complex.ext_iff, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_add, add_mul, pow_two]
      ring_nf
      norm_num [pow_two, mul_add, mul_assoc, Complex.ext_iff, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Real.sqrt_mul_self]
    · -- Fourth case: x = 4 - i*sqrt(5)
      rw [h]
      simp [pow_two, pow_three, pow_succ, Complex.ext_iff, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_add, add_mul, pow_two]
      ring_nf
      norm_num [pow_two, mul_add, mul_assoc, Complex.ext_iff, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Real.sqrt_mul_self]

theorem algebra_306038 {a b c : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0)

  have eq1 : a * (1 / b + 1 / c) + b * (1 / c + 1 / a) + c * (1 / a + 1 / b) = 
    (a * (b + c) ) / (b * c) + (b * (a + c) ) / (a * c) + (c * (a + b) ) / (a * b) := by 
    field_simp [hb, hc, ha]
    <;> ring

  have eq2 : (a * (b + c) ) / (b * c) + (b * (a + c) ) / (a * c) + (c * (a + b) ) / (a * b) = -3 := by 
    linarith [h2, eq1]

  have eq3 : a^2 * (b + c) + b^2 * (a + c) + c^2 * (a + b) + 3 * a * b * c = 0 := by
    have h3 : a * b * c ≠ 0 := by
      apply mul_ne_zero

      exact hc

            apply mul_ne_zero ha hb ]
      ring

    field_simp [h3] at eq2 ⊢ 
    nlinarith 

  have eq4 : (a + b + c) * (a * b + b * c + c * a) = 0 := by 
    nlinarith [eq3]

  cases (mul_eq_zero.mp eq4) with

    right 
    right

    have h5 : (a + b + c)^2 = 1 := by

        tauto 
      assumption

    cases h6 with
    | inl h7 =>
      left 
      linarith
    | inr h8 =>

theorem algebra_227819 (x : ℝ) :
    (1 + x + x^2) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 11, x ^ i =
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range 7, x ^ i) ^ 2 ↔ x = -1 ∨ x = 0 := by
  constructor
  · -- Assume left side, prove right side
    intro h_eq
    simp [Finset.sum_range_succ] at h_eq
    have h_eq2 : x ^ 3 * (x ^ 8 - 2 * x ^ 4 + 1) = 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x ^ 4 - 1), sq_nonneg (x ^ 2 - 1), sq_nonneg (x + 1), sq_nonneg (x), sq_nonneg (x ^ 2), sq_nonneg (x ^ 3), sq_nonneg (x ^ 5)]
    cases' (mul_eq_zero.mp h_eq2) with h1 h2
    · -- Case $x^3 = 0$, so $x = 0$
      right

        nlinarith
      have h_eq00 : x = 0 := by
        have : x ^ 3 = 0 := h_eq0
        simp at this ⊢
        <;> nlinarith
      exact h_eq00
    · -- Case $x^8 - 2 * x^4 + 1 = 0$
      have h_eq3 : x ^ 8 - 2 * x ^ 4 + 1 = 0 := by
        nlinarith
      have h_eq4 : (x ^ 4 - 1) ^ 2 = 0 := by
        nlinarith
      have h_eq5 : x ^ 4 - 1 = 0 := by

        exact h_eq4
      have h_eq6 : x ^ 4 = 1 := by
        linarith
      have h_eq7 : x ^ 2 = 1 ∨ x ^ 2 = -1 := by
        have : (x ^ 2 - 1) * (x ^ 2 + 1) = 0 := by
          nlinarith

        · -- Case x^2 -1 = 0, so x^2 =1

/- Compute the number of degrees in the smallest positive angle $x$ such that
\[8 \sin x \cos^5 x - 8 \sin^5 x \cos x = 1.\] -/
theorem calculus_13255 :
  IsLeast {x : ℝ | 0 < x ∧ 8 * sin x * cos x ^ 5 - 8 * sin x ^ 5 * cos x = 1} (7.5 * π / 180) := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Real Set
open scoped Real

theorem calculus_13255 :
  IsLeast {x : ℝ | 0 < x ∧ 8 * sin x * cos x ^ 5 - 8 * sin x ^ 5 * cos x = 1} (7.5 * π / 180) := by 
  constructor
  · -- Show that 7.5 * π / 180 is in the set.
    constructor
    · -- Show that it's positive.
      have h1 : 0 < 7.5 * π / 180 := by 
        nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
      linarith
    · -- Show that it satisfies the equation.
      have h2 : 8 * sin (7.5 * π / 180) * cos (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 5 - 8 * sin (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 5 * cos (7.5 * π / 180) = 1 := by
        have h3 : 8 * sin (7.5 * π / 180) * cos (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 5 - 8 * sin (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 5 * cos (7.5 * π / 180) = 2 * sin (4 * (7.5 * π / 180)) := by
          have h31 : 8 * sin (7.5 * π / 180) * cos (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 5 - 8 * sin (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 5 * cos (7.5 * π / 180) = 8 * sin (7.5 * π / 180) * cos (7.5 * π / 180) * (cos (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 4 - sin (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 4) := by 
            ring_nf
          rw [h31]
          have h32 : cos (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 4 - sin (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 4 = (cos (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 2 - sin (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 2) * (cos (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 2 + sin (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 2) := by 
            ring_nf
          have h33 : cos (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 2 + sin (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 2 = 1 := by 
            have h4 : sin (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 2 + cos (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 2 = 1 := by 
              exact Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (7.5 * π / 180)
            linarith
          rw [h32, h33]
          have h34 : sin (4 * (7.5 * π / 180)) = 2 * sin (2 * (7.5 * π / 180)) * cos (2 * (7.5 * π / 180)) := by 
            rw [show 4 * (7.5 * π / 180) = 2 * (2 * (7.5 * π / 180)) by ring]
            rw [sin_two_mul]
          have h35 : sin (2 * (7.5 * π / 180)) = 2 * sin (7.5 * π / 180) * cos (7.5 * π / 180) := by 
            rw [sin_two_mul]
          have h36 : cos (2 * (7.5 * π / 180)) = cos (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 2 - sin (7.5 * π / 180) ^ 2 := by 
            rw [cos_two_mul]
            rw [sin_sq, cos_sq]
            <;> ring_nf 
          rw [h34, h35, h36]
          all_goals ring_nf
        rw [h3] 
        have h4 : 4 * (7.5 * π / 180) = Real.pi / 6 := by
          ring_nf
        rw [h4]
        have h5 : sin (Real.pi / 6) = 1 / 2 := by 
          rw [sin_pi_div_six]
        rw [h5]
        all_goals linarith 
      linarith [h2]
  · -- Show that it's minimal.
    intro x ⟨hx_pos, hx_eq⟩
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h 
    have h1 : 8 * sin x * cos x ^ 5 - 8 * sin x ^ 5 * cos x = 2 * sin (4 * x) := by
      have h31 : 8 * sin x * cos x ^ 5 - 8 * sin x ^ 5 * cos x = 8 * sin x * cos x * (cos x ^ 4 - sin x ^ 4) := by 
        ring_nf
      have h32 : cos x ^ 4 - sin x ^ 4 = (cos x ^ 2 - sin x ^ 2) * (cos x ^ 2 + sin x ^ 2) := by 
        ring_nf
      have h33 : cos x ^ 2 + sin x ^ 2 = 1 := by 
        have h34 : sin x ^ 2 + cos x ^ 2 = 1 := by 
          exact Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq x 
        linarith
      calc 
        8 * sin x * cos x ^ 5 - 8 * sin x ^ 5 * cos x
          = 8 * sin x * cos x * (cos x ^ 4 - sin x ^ 4) := by 
            ring_nf 
        _ = 8 * sin x * cos x * ((cos x ^ 2 - sin x ^ 2) * (cos x ^ 2 + sin x ^ 2)) := by 
          rw [h32]
        _ = 8 * sin x * cos x * (cos x ^ 2 - sin x ^ 2) := by
          rw [h33]
          <;> ring_nf 
        _ = 4 * (2 * sin x * cos x) * (cos x ^ 2 - sin x ^ 2) := by
          ring_nf 
        _ = 2 * sin (4 * x) := by 
          have h36 : sin (4 * x) = 2 * sin (2 * x) * cos (2 * x) := by 
            rw [show 4 * x = 2 * (2 * x) by ring]
            rw [sin_two_mul]
          have h37 : sin (2 * x) = 2 * sin x * cos x := by

$$
a_{n}=\frac{a_{n-1}}{\sqrt{1+2020 \cdot a_{n-1}^{2}}}, \quad \text { for } n=1,2, \ldots, 2020
$$

Show that $a_{2020}<\frac{1}{2020}$. -/
theorem algebra_606369 (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : a 0 > 0) (hn : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = a n / √(1 + 2020 * (a n) ^ 2)) : a 2020 < 1 / 2020 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_606369 (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : a 0 > 0) (hn : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = a n / √(1 + 2020 * (a n) ^ 2)) : a 2020 < 1 / 2020 := by

  have h1 : ∀ n : ℕ, a n ^ 2 = a 0 ^ 2 / (1 + (n : ℝ) * 2020 * a 0 ^ 2) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      field_simp
    | succ n ih =>
      have h2 : a (n + 1) = a n / √(1 + 2020 * (a n) ^ 2) := by
        specialize hn n
        simpa using hn
      have h4 : a (n + 1) ^ 2 = (a n) ^ 2 / (1 + 2020 * (a n) ^ 2) := by
        rw [h2]
        have h5 : (√(1 + 2020 * (a n) ^ 2)) ^ 2 = 1 + 2020 * (a n) ^ 2 := by
          exact Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
        field_simp [h5]
        <;> nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + 2020 * (a n) ^ 2), Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 + 2020 * (a n) ^ 2) by positivity)]
      rw [h4]
      rw [ih]
      field_simp
      ring_nf

  have h2 : a 2020 ^ 2 < (1 / 2020) ^ 2 := by
    have h3 : a 2020 ^ 2 = a 0 ^ 2 / (1 + (2020 : ℝ) * 2020 * a 0 ^ 2) := by
      specialize h1 2020
      norm_num at h1 ⊢
      linarith
    rw [h3]
    have h4 : a 0 > 0 := h0
    have h5 : a 0 ^ 2 > 0 := by
      nlinarith [h4]
    have h6 : 0 < (1 + (2020 : ℝ) * 2020 * a 0 ^ 2) := by
      nlinarith [h4]
    have h7 : (a 0 ^ 2 / (1 + (2020 : ℝ) * 2020 * a 0 ^ 2)) < (1 / 2020) ^ 2 := by
      have h8 : (1 / 2020 : ℝ) ^ 2 = 1 / (2020 ^ 2 : ℝ) := by
        norm_num
      rw [h8]
      have h9 : a 0 ^ 2 / (1 + (2020 : ℝ) * 2020 * a 0 ^ 2) < 1 / (2020 ^ 2 : ℝ) := by
        apply (div_lt_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr
        nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos h4]
      linarith
    linarith

  have h3 : a 2020 > 0 := by
    have h4 : ∀ n : ℕ, a n > 0 := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        exact h0
      | succ n ih =>
        have h2 : a (n + 1) = a n / √(1 + 2020 * (a n) ^ 2) := by
          specialize hn n
          simpa using hn
        rw [h2]
        apply div_pos
        exact ih
        positivity
    specialize h4 2020
    linarith

  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a 2020 - 1 / 2020), h3]

formal_proof:

theorem inequalities_208322 : logb 3 4 > logb 4 5 := by 
  have h1 : logb 3 4 = (log 4) / (log 3) := by 
    field_simp [logb]
    all_goals linarith 
  have h2 : logb 4 5 = (log 5) / (log 4) := by 
    field_simp [logb]
    all_goals linarith 
  rw [h1, h2]
  have h3 : log 3 > 0 := by
    apply log_pos 
    all_goals linarith 
  have h4 : log 4 > 0 := by 
    apply log_pos 
    all_goals linarith 
  have h5 : log 4 > log 3 := by 
    have h1 : log 4 > log 3 := by 
      apply Real.log_lt_log 
      all_goals linarith 
    linarith 
  have h6 : log 5 > log 4 := by 
    have h2 : log 5 > log 4 := by 
      apply Real.log_lt_log 
      all_goals linarith 
    linarith 
  have h7 : (log 4) ^ 2 > (log 3) * (log 5) := by 
    have h8 : log (16 : ℝ) = 2 * log 4 := by 
      calc 
        log (16 : ℝ) = log ((4 : ℝ) ^ 2) := by norm_num 
        _ = 2 * log (4 : ℝ) := by simp [log_pow]
    have h9 : log (15 : ℝ) = log 3 + log 5 := by 
      calc 
        log (15 : ℝ) = log ((3 : ℝ) * (5 : ℝ)) := by norm_num 
        _ = log (3 : ℝ) + log (5 : ℝ) := by rw [log_mul (by linarith) (by linarith)]
    have h10 : log (16 : ℝ) > log (15 : ℝ) := by 
      apply Real.log_lt_log 
      all_goals linarith 
    have h11 : 2 * log 4 > log 3 + log 5 := by 
      linarith [h8, h9, h10] 
    nlinarith [Real.log_pos (show (4 : ℝ) > 1 by norm_num : (4 : ℝ) > 1), Real.log_pos (show (5 : ℝ) > 1 by norm_num : (5 : ℝ) > 1), Real.log_pos (show (3 : ℝ) > 1 by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) > 1),
      mul_pos (show 0 < (4 : ℝ) - (3 : ℝ) by linarith) (show 0 < (5 : ℝ) - (4 : ℝ) by linarith),
      h11]
  have h8 : (log 4) / (log 3) > (log 5) / (log 4) := by

    nlinarith [Real.log_pos (show (4 : ℝ) > 1 by norm_num : (4 : ℝ) > 1), Real.log_pos (show (5 : ℝ) > 1 by norm_num : (5 : ℝ) > 1), Real.log_pos (show (3 : ℝ) > 1 by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) > 1)]

theorem algebra_6413
    {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (h : x + 1/x = 1) :

formal_proof:

theorem algebra_6413
    {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (h : x + 1/x = 1) :
    x^(2020) + 1/x^(2020) = -1 := by 
  -- Manipulate the equation to get a polynomial equation
  have h1 : x ^ 2 + 1 = x := by 
    calc 
      x ^ 2 + 1 = x * (x + 1/x) := by 
        field_simp 
        <;> ring 
      _ = x * 1 := by 
        rw [h] 
      _ = x := by 
        ring 
  have h2 : x ^ 2 = x - 1 := by
    linarith 
  -- Now compute x^3
  have h3 : x ^ 3 = -1 := by
    calc 
      x ^ 3 = x * x ^ 2 := by 
        ring 
      _ = x * (x - 1) := by 
        rw [h2]
      _ = x ^ 2 - x := by 
        ring 
      _ = (x - 1) - x := by 
        rw [h2]
      _ = -1 := by 
        linarith 
  -- Now compute x^6
  have h4 : x ^ 6 = 1 := by
    calc 
      x ^ 6 = (x ^ 3) ^ 2 := by 
        ring 
      _ = (-1) ^ 2 := by 
        rw [h3]
      _ = 1 := by 
        norm_num 
  -- Now compute x^4 
  have h5 : x ^ 4 = -x := by
    calc 
      x ^ 4 = x * x ^ 3 := by 
        ring 
      _ = x * (-1) := by 
        rw [h3]
      _ = -x := by 
        ring 
  -- Now compute x^2020
  have h6 : x ^ 2020 = x ^ 4 := by 
    calc
      x ^ 2020 = (x ^ 6) ^ 336 * x ^ 4 := by 
        ring_nf 
      _ = (1) ^ 336 * x ^ 4 := by 
        rw [h4]
      _ = x ^ 4 := by 
        ring 
  -- Make substitutions in $x^2020 + \frac{1}{x^2020}$ 
  have eq10 : x^(2020) + 1/x^(2020) = x^4 + 1/x^4 := by
    rw [show x ^ 2020 = x ^ 4 by linarith [h6]]
    <;> field_simp [hx] at *
    <;> norm_num
  rw [eq10]
  have h7 : x^2 + 1 / x^2 = -1 := by 
    have eq11 : x^2 + 1 / x^2 = (x + 1 / x) ^ 2 - 2 := by 
      field_simp [hx] 
      <;> ring

    have eq12 : x^4 + 1 / x^4 = (x^2 + 1 / x^2) ^ 2 - 2 := by
      field_simp [hx] 
      <;> ring 
    rw [eq12, h7]
    all_goals

  linarith [h8]

/- 2. Solve the inequality $x^{2}+2 x+1-\left|x^{3}+1\right|-2\left(x^{2}-x+1\right)^{2} \leqslant 0$. -/
theorem inequalities_148917 (x : ℝ) :
  x^2 + 2 * x + 1 - abs (x^3 + 1) - 2 * (x^2 - x + 1)^2 ≤ 0 ↔
  x ≤ 1 / 2 ∨ x ≥ 1 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Real Set
open scoped BigOperators

theorem inequalities_148917 (x : ℝ) :
  x^2 + 2 * x + 1 - abs (x^3 + 1) - 2 * (x^2 - x + 1)^2 ≤ 0 ↔
  x ≤ 1 / 2 ∨ x ≥ 1 := by
  constructor
  · -- Forward direction: prove that if the inequality holds, then x ≤ 1/2 or x ≥ 1
    intro h
    by_cases h1 : x^3 + 1 ≥ 0
    · -- Case where x^3 + 1 ≥ 0, so abs (x^3 + 1) = x^3 + 1
      have h2 : abs (x^3 + 1) = x^3 + 1 := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg h1]
      rw [h2] at h
      by_cases h3 : x ≤ 1 / 2
      · -- If x ≤ 1/2, then it holds
        left
        exact h3
      · -- Case where x > 1/2
        have h4 : x > 1 / 2 := by linarith
        by_cases h5 : x ≥ 1
        · -- If x ≥ 1, then it holds
          right
          linarith

(A) does not exist.
(B) $-21$ or $k<-2$.
(E) all real numbers.
(13th American High School Mathematics Examination, 1962) -/

formal_proof:

theorem algebra_256977 (k : ℝ) :
    ∃ x : ℝ, x ≠ 1 ∧ x ≠ 2 ∧ x = k^2 * (x - 1) * (x - 2) := by
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · -- When k = 0, x = 0 is a solution.
    use (0 : ℝ)
    constructor
    · -- Show 0 ≠ 1
      norm_num
    constructor
    · -- Show 0 ≠ 2
      norm_num
    · -- Show 0 = 0^2 * (0 - 1) * (0 - 2)
      norm_num [hk]
  · -- Case k ≠ 0
    have hk2 : k ≠ 0 := by 
      intro h'
      apply hk
      linarith
    use (3 * k^2 + 1 + Real.sqrt (k^4 + 6 * k^2 + 1)) / (2 * k^2)
    constructor
    · -- Show x ≠ 1
      by_contra h1
      have eq1 : (3 * k^2 + 1 + Real.sqrt (k^4 + 6 * k^2 + 1)) / (2 * k^2) = 1 := by
        linarith [h1]
      have eq2 : 3 * k^2 + 1 + Real.sqrt (k^4 + 6 * k^2 + 1) = 2 * k^2 := by
        have h1' : 2 * k^2 ≠ 0 := by
          have hk' : k^2 > 0 := by
            have : k ≠ 0 := hk2
            have : k^2 > 0 := by 
              exact sq_pos_of_ne_zero this
            linarith
          nlinarith
        field_simp [h1'] at eq1 ⊢
        all_goals
        nlinarith [eq1]
      have eq3 : Real.sqrt (k^4 + 6 * k^2 + 1) = -k^2 - 1 := by
        nlinarith
      have h5 : Real.sqrt (k^4 + 6 * k^2 + 1) ≥ 0 := by
        apply Real.sqrt_nonneg
      -- From eq3 and h5, we get -k^2 - 1 ≥ 0
      have h5' : -k^2 - 1 ≥ (0 : ℝ) := by
        nlinarith [eq3, h5]
      -- Which means k^2 ≤ -1, which is impossible
      -- because k^2 ≥ 0 for real numbers k.
      have h6 : k^2 ≤ (-1 : ℝ) := by
        nlinarith
      have h7 : k^2 ≥ (0 : ℝ) := by 
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg k]
      nlinarith
    constructor
    · -- Show x ≠ 2
      by_contra h2
      have eq1 : (3 * k^2 + 1 + Real.sqrt (k^4 + 6 * k^2 + 1)) / (2 * k^2) = 2 := by
        linarith [h2]
      have eq2 : 3 * k^2 + 1 + Real.sqrt (k^4 + 6 * k^2 + 1) = 4 * k^2 := by
        have h1' : 2 * k^2 ≠ 0 := by
          have hk' : k^2 > 0 := by
            have : k ≠ 0 := hk2
            have : k^2 > 0 := by 
              exact sq_pos_of_ne_zero this
            linarith
          nlinarith
        field_simp [h1'] at eq1 ⊢
        all_goals
        nlinarith [eq1]
      have eq3 : Real.sqrt (k^4 + 6 * k^2 + 1) = k^2 - 1 := by
        nlinarith
      have h5 : Real.sqrt (k^4 + 6 * k^2 + 1) ≥ 0 := by
        apply Real.sqrt_nonneg
      have h5' : k^2 - 1 ≥ (0 : ℝ) := by 
        nlinarith [eq3, h5]
      have h6 : Real.sqrt (k^4 + 6 * k^2 + 1) ^ 2 = (k^2 - 1) ^ 2 := by
        rw [eq3]
      have h7 : Real.sqrt (k^4 + 6 * k^2 + 1) ^ 2 = k^4 + 6 * k^2 + 1 := by
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (k^2), sq_nonneg k, sq_nonneg (k^4 + 6 * k^2 + 1)]
        all_goals nlinarith
      have eq8 : k^4 + 6 * k^2 + 1 = (k^2 - 1)^2 := by
        nlinarith [h6, h7]
      have eq9 : (k^2 - 1)^2 = k^4 - 2 * k^2 + 1 := by
        nlinarith
      have eq10 : k^2 = 0 := by
        nlinarith [eq8, eq9]
      have eq11 : k = 0 := by
        nlinarith
      tauto
    · -- Show x = k^2 * (x - 1) * (x - 2)
      field_simp
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (k^4 + 6 * k^2 + 1), 
        Real.sq_sqrt (show k^4 + 6 * k^2 + 1 ≥ 0 by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (k^2), sq_nonneg k, sq_nonneg (k^4 + 6 * k^2 + 1)])]

    · linarith
  have h4 : 0 < (2 + Real.sqrt 2) / (2 - Real.sqrt 2) := by

      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) by norm_num), Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) by norm_num)]

    have h9 : ((2 + Real.sqrt 2) / (2 - Real.sqrt 2) : ℝ) = (3 + 2 * Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) := by

/- A line segment is divided so that the lesser part is to the greater part as the greater part is to the whole. If $R$ is the ratio of the lesser part to the greater part, then the value of 
\[R^{[R^{(R^2+R^{-1})}+R^{-1}]}+R^{-1}\]
is
$\mathrm{(A)\ } 2 \qquad \mathrm{(B) \ }2R \qquad \mathrm{(C) \  } R^{-1} \qquad \mathrm{(D) \  } 2+R^{-1} \qquad \mathrm{(E) \  }2+R$ -/
theorem algebra_97733 {R : ℝ} (hR : R > 0) (h : R = (1 - R) / R) :
    R ^ (R ^ (R ^ 2 + 1 / R) + 1 / R) + 1 / R = 2 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_97733 {R : ℝ} (hR : R > 0) (h : R = (1 - R) / R) :
    R ^ (R ^ (R ^ 2 + 1 / R) + 1 / R) + 1 / R = 2 := by
  have h1 : R ≠ 0 := by nlinarith 
  have eq1 : R * R = 1 - R := by
    field_simp [h1] at h
    nlinarith
  have eq2 : R ^ 2 = 1 - R := by
    nlinarith
  have eq3 : 1 / R = 1 + R := by 
    field_simp [h1]
    nlinarith [eq2]
  have eq4 : R ^ 2 + 1 / R = 2 := by
    rw [eq3]
    nlinarith [eq2]
  -- Show that R^(R^2 + 1/R) = R^2
  have eq5 : R ^ (R ^ 2 + 1 / R) = R ^ 2 := by 
    rw [eq4]
    all_goals norm_num
    all_goals nlinarith
  -- Show that R^(R^(R^2 + 1/R) + 1/R) = R^2
  have eq6 : R ^ (R ^ (R ^ 2 + 1 / R) + 1 / R) = R ^ 2 := by 
    have h_eq1 : R ^ (R ^ 2 + 1 / R) = R ^ 2 := eq5
    have h_eq2 : R ^ (R ^ 2 + 1 / R) + 1 / R = 2 := by
      rw [h_eq1]
      rw [eq3]
      nlinarith [eq2]
    rw [h_eq2]
    all_goals norm_num
    all_goals nlinarith
  -- Compute the final result
  calc
    R ^ (R ^ (R ^ 2 + 1 / R) + 1 / R) + 1 / R = R ^ 2 + 1 / R := by rw [eq6]
    _ = 2 := eq4

theorem number_theory_90650 (n : ℤ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, Real.sqrt ((n ^ 2 - 5) / (n + 1)) = q ↔ n = 3 := by
formal_proof:

theorem number_theory_90650 (n : ℤ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, Real.sqrt ((n ^ 2 - 5) / (n + 1)) = q ↔ n = 3 := by 
  by_cases h : n = 3
  · -- Assume n = 3. Then the sqrt is equal to 1, so take q=1
    use 1
    rw [h]
    norm_num
  · -- Assume n ≠ 3
    have hne : n > 3 := by 
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      omega
    have h1 : (n + 1 : ℚ) > (0 : ℚ) := by
      have h' : 3 ≤ n := hn
      have h'2 : n + 1 ≥ 4 := by omega
      have h2 : (n + 1 : ℚ) ≥ (4 : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast h'2
      nlinarith
    have h3 : Real.sqrt ((n ^ 2 - 5) / (n + 1)) > (0 : ℝ) := by
      have h4 : (n ^ 2 - 5 : ℝ) / (n + 1 : ℝ) > 0 := by
        have h5 : (n + 1 : ℝ) > 0 := by
          exact_mod_cast show (n + 1 : ℚ) > (0 : ℚ) by linarith
        have h6 : (n ^ 2 - 5 : ℝ) > 0 := by
          have : n ≥ 3 := by omega
          have : n ^ 2 ≥ 9 := by nlinarith
          have : (n ^ 2 - 5 : ℝ) ≥ (4 : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast (show n ^ 2 - 5 ≥ 4 from by nlinarith)
          nlinarith
        exact div_pos h6 h5
      apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
      exact h4
    use (0 : ℚ)
    constructor
    · -- Assume sqrt = 0, which contradicts sqrt > 0
      intro h
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg ((n ^ 2 - 5) / (n + 1)), h3]
    · -- Assume n = 3 from right side satisfies (which it doesn't, so makes LHS which should satisfy integer real Smith). 
      intro h
      have h5 : n = 3 := by
        exact_mod_cast h
      exfalso
      omega

  have eq2 : f k2 = k2 ^ 2 + b * k2 + c := hf k2

/- 1. Given the function $f(x)=|2 x-4|-3 x+8$ $(x \in \mathbf{R})$. Then the analytical expression of the inverse function $f^{-1}(x)$ is ( ).
(A) $f^{-1}(x)=-x+4(x \in \mathbf{R})$
(B) $f^{-1}(x)=-\frac{1}{5} x+\frac{12}{5}(x \in \mathbf{R})$
(C) $f^{-1}(x)=\left\{\begin{array}{l}-x+4, x \leqslant 2 ; \\ -\frac{1}{5} x+\frac{12}{5}, x>2\end{array}\right.$
(D) $f^{-1}(x)=\left\{\begin{array}{l}-\frac{1}{5} x+\frac{12}{5}, x<2 ; \\ -x+4, x \geqslant 2\end{array}\right.$ -/
theorem algebra_322221 {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : f = λ x => abs (2 * x - 4) - 3 * x + 8) :
    ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ, Function.LeftInverse g f ∧
      ∀ x, g x = if x ≤ 2 then -x + 4 else -1 / 5 * x + 12 / 5 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Real Set
open scoped BigOperators

theorem algebra_322221 {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : f = λ x => abs (2 * x - 4) - 3 * x + 8) :
    ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ, Function.LeftInverse g f ∧
      ∀ x, g x = if x ≤ 2 then -x + 4 else -1 / 5 * x + 12 / 5 := by 
  use λ x => if x ≤ 2 then -x + 4 else -1 / 5 * x + 12 / 5
  constructor
  · -- Show that g is a left inverse of f, i.e., g(f(x)) = x for all x.
    intro x
    rw [hf]
    by_cases h : x ≥ 2
    · -- When x ≥ 2, |2x - 4| = 2x - 4
      have h1 : abs (2 * x - 4) = 2 * x - 4 := abs_of_nonneg (show 2 * x - 4 ≥ 0 by linarith)
      have hx1 : abs (2 * x - 4) - 3 * x + 8 = -x + 4 := by 
        rw [h1]
        linarith
      have h13 : abs (2 * x - 4) - 3 * x + 8 ≤ 2 := by 
        have h14 : abs (2 * x - 4) = 2 * x - 4 := abs_of_nonneg (show 2 * x - 4 ≥ 0 by linarith)
        linarith
      have eq1 : (fun y => if y ≤ 2 then -y + 4 else -1/5 * y + 12/5) (abs (2 * x - 4) - 3 * x + 8) =
          -(abs (2 * x - 4) - 3 * x + 8) + 4 := by
        have h19 : abs (2 * x - 4) - 3 * x + 8 ≤ (2 : ℝ) := by 
          linarith
        simp [show abs (2 * x - 4) - 3 * x + 8 ≤ (2 : ℝ) by linarith]
      rw [eq1]
      all_goals
        linarith
    · -- When x < 2, |2x - 4| = -(2x - 4) = -2x + 4
      have h1 : abs (2 * x - 4) = -(2 * x - 4) := abs_of_neg (show 2 * x - 4 < 0 by linarith)
      have hx1 : abs (2 * x - 4) - 3 * x + 8 = -5 * x + 12 := by 
        rw [h1]
        linarith
      have h13 : abs (2 * x - 4) - 3 * x + 8 > (2 : ℝ) := by 
        have h14 : abs (2 * x - 4) = -(2 * x - 4) := abs_of_neg (show 2 * x - 4 < 0 by linarith)
        linarith
      have eq1 : (fun y => if y ≤ 2 then -y + 4 else -1/5 * y + 12/5) (abs (2 * x - 4) - 3 * x + 8) =
         (-1/5) * (abs (2 * x - 4) - 3 * x + 8) + 12/5 := by 
        have h19 : ¬ (abs (2 * x - 4) - 3 * x + 8 ≤ (2 : ℝ)) := by 
          linarith 
        simp [show ¬ (abs (2 * x - 4) - 3 * x + 8 ≤ (2 : ℝ)) by linarith, h19]
      rw [eq1]
      all_goals 
        linarith
  · -- Show that g x = if x ≤ 2 then -x + 4 else -1 / 5 * x + 12 / 5
    intro x 
    rfl

$$

$$ -/
theorem inequalities_102950 (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : a + b + c = 3) :
    a / (1 + b) + b / (1 + c) + c / (1 + a) ≥
    1 / (1 + a) + 1 / (1 + b) + 1 / (1 + c) := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem inequalities_102950 (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : a + b + c = 3) :
    a / (1 + b) + b / (1 + c) + c / (1 + a) ≥
    1 / (1 + a) + 1 / (1 + b) + 1 / (1 + c) := by
  have h1 : a / (1 + b) + b / (1 + c) + c / (1 + a) - (1 / (1 + a) + 1 / (1 + b) + 1 / (1 + c)) ≥ 0 := by
    have h2 : a / (1 + b) + b / (1 + c) + c / (1 + a) - (1 / (1 + a) + 1 / (1 + b) + 1 / (1 + c)) = (a - 1) / (1 + b) + (b - 1) / (1 + c) + (c - 1) / (1 + a) := by 
      field_simp
      <;> ring
    rw [h2]
    have h3 : (a - 1) / (1 + b) + (b - 1) / (1 + c) + (c - 1) / (1 + a) ≥ 0 := by
      have h4 : 0 < (1 + a) * (1 + b) * (1 + c) := by
        positivity
      have h5 : (a - 1) / (1 + b) + (b - 1) / (1 + c) + (c - 1) / (1 + a) = ((a - 1) * (1 + a) * (1 + c) + (b - 1) * (1 + b) * (1 + a) + (c - 1) * (1 + c) * (1 + b)) / ((1 + a) * (1 + b) * (1 + c)) := by
        field_simp
        <;> ring
      rw [h5] at *
      apply div_nonneg
      · -- Prove the numerator is non-negative
        have h7 : a + b + c = 3 := h
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (a - c), sq_nonneg (b - c),
          sq_nonneg (a - 1), sq_nonneg (b - 1), sq_nonneg (c - 1),
          mul_nonneg ha hb, mul_nonneg ha hc, mul_nonneg hb hc]
      · -- Prove the denominator is non-negative
        positivity
    linarith
  linarith

$$
x+y+z \geq \sqrt{\frac{x y+1}{2}}+\sqrt{\frac{y z+1}{2}}+\sqrt{\frac{z x+1}{2}}
$$

b) (Added by the problem selecting committee) When does the equality hold?

 -/
theorem inequalities_105220 (x y z : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hz : 0 < z)
    (h : x + y + z = 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z) :
    x + y + z ≥ sqrt ((x * y + 1) / 2) + sqrt ((y * z + 1) / 2) +
    sqrt ((z * x + 1) / 2) := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Real

theorem inequalities_105220 (x y z : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hz : 0 < z)
    (h : x + y + z = 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z) :
    x + y + z ≥ sqrt ((x * y + 1) / 2) + sqrt ((y * z + 1) / 2) +
    sqrt ((z * x + 1) / 2) := by
  have h1 : 0 < x * y * z := by
    positivity
  have h2 : x + y + z = (x * y + y * z + z * x) / (x * y * z) := by
    field_simp at h ⊢
    nlinarith [h, mul_pos hx hy, mul_pos hx hz, mul_pos hy hz, h1]
  have h3 : x * y * z * (x + y + z) = x * y + y * z + z * x := by
    field_simp at h2 ⊢
    nlinarith
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (sqrt ((x * y + 1) / 2) - x), sq_nonneg (sqrt ((y * z + 1) / 2) - y), sq_nonneg (sqrt ((z * x + 1) / 2) - z), 
          Real.sqrt_nonneg ((x * y + 1) / 2), Real.sqrt_nonneg ((y * z + 1) / 2), Real.sqrt_nonneg ((z * x + 1) / 2), 
          Real.sq_sqrt (show (x * y + 1) / 2 ≥ 0 by positivity), 
          Real.sq_sqrt (show (y * z + 1) / 2 ≥ 0 by positivity), 
          Real.sq_sqrt (show (z * x + 1) / 2 ≥ 0 by positivity), 
          sq_nonneg (x - y), sq_nonneg (y - z), sq_nonneg (z - x), 
          mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ (x * y + 1) / 2 by positivity) (show 0 ≤ (y * z + 1) / 2 by positivity), 
          Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (show (x * y + 1) / 2 ≥ 0 by positivity), Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (show (y * z + 1) / 2 ≥ 0 by positivity), h2, h, h1, mul_pos hx hy, mul_pos hy hz, mul_pos hz hx]

/- 3. (1990 Fujian Province High School Competition Question) The natural number values of $n$ that make $n^{5}-5 n^{3}+4 n+7$ a perfect square ( ).
A. There is exactly one
B. There are a finite number, but more than one
C. There are infinitely many
D. None exist -/
theorem number_theory_106637 :
    ¬∃ n : ℕ, ∃ k : ℕ, (n ^ 5 - 5 * n ^ 3 + 4 * n + 7) = k ^ 2 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem number_theory_106637 :
    ¬∃ n : ℕ, ∃ k : ℕ, (n ^ 5 - 5 * n ^ 3 + 4 * n + 7) = k ^ 2 := by
  rintro ⟨n, ⟨k, hk⟩⟩
  have h1 : n ^ 5 - 5 * n ^ 3 + 4 * n + 7 = k ^ 2 := by 
    omega 
  have h2 : k ^ 2 % 4 = 0 ∨ k ^ 2 % 4 = 1 := by 
    have h : k % 4 = 0 ∨ k % 4 = 1 ∨ k % 4 = 2 ∨ k % 4 = 3 := by 
      omega 
    rcases h with (h | h | h | h)
    · -- k % 4 = 0
      simp [h, Nat.pow_mod]
      all_goals omega 
    · -- k % 4 = 1
      simp [h, Nat.pow_mod]
      all_goals omega 
    · -- k % 4 = 2
      simp [h, Nat.pow_mod]
      all_goals omega 
    · -- k % 4 = 3
      simp [h, Nat.pow_mod]
      all_goals omega 
  have h3 : (n ^ 5 - 5 * n ^ 3 + 4 * n + 7) % 4 = 3 := by 
    have h4 : n % 4 = 0 ∨ n % 4 = 1 ∨ n % 4 = 2 ∨ n % 4 = 3 := by 
      omega 
    rcases h4 with (h4 | h4 | h4 | h4)
    · -- n % 4 = 0 
      simp [h4, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.sub_mod_eq_zero_of_mod_eq, show n ^ 5 % 4 = 0 by simp [h4, Nat.pow_mod], show 5 * n ^ 3 % 4 = 0 by simp [h4, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mul_mod], show (4 * n) % 4 = 0 by simp [h4, Nat.mul_mod] ] at *
      all_goals omega 
    · -- n % 4 = 1 
      simp [h4, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.sub_mod_eq_zero_of_mod_eq, show n ^ 5 % 4 = 1 by simp [h4, Nat.pow_mod], show 5 * n ^ 3 % 4 = 1 by simp [h4, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mul_mod], show (4 * n) % 4 = 0 by simp [h4, Nat.mul_mod] ] at *
      all_goals omega 
    · -- n % 4 = 2 
      simp [h4, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.sub_mod_eq_zero_of_mod_eq, show n ^ 5 % 4 = 0 by simp [h4, Nat.pow_mod], show 5 * n ^ 3 % 4 = 0 by simp [h4, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mul_mod], show (4 * n) % 4 = 0 by simp [h4, Nat.mul_mod] ] at *
      all_goals omega 
    · -- n % 4 = 3
      simp [h4, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.sub_mod_eq_zero_of_mod_eq, show n ^ 5 % 4 = 3 by simp [h4, Nat.pow_mod], show 5 * n ^ 3 % 4 = 3 by simp [h4, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mul_mod], show (4 * n) % 4 = 0 by simp [h4, Nat.mul_mod] ] at *
      all_goals omega 
  have h5 : k ^ 2 % 4 = 3 := by 
    omega 
  omega 
  all_goals omega 
  all_goals ring_nf at h1 
  all_goals omega 
  <;> omega 
  <;> tauto 
  all_goals tauto

$$
\begin{array}{l}
x+y+z=100 \\

theorem number_theory_4632_a (x y z : ℤ) (h1 : x + y + z = 100)

    have h4 : y = 8 - 7 * z := by linarith
    have h5 : x = 92 + 6 * z := by linarith

/-- Find all integer solutions of the following systems of linear Diophantine equations:
b)
$$\begin{array}{l}
x+y+z=100 \\
x+6y+21z=121
\end{array}$$-/
theorem number_theory_4632_b (x y z : ℤ) (h1 : x + y + z = 100)
  (h2 : x + 6 * y + 21 * z = 121) : False := by
    have h3 : 5 * y + 20 * z = 21 := by linarith
    have h4 : 5 * y + 20 * z ≡ 21 [ZMOD 5] := congrFun (congrArg HMod.hMod h3) 5
    have h5 : 5 * y ≡ 0 [ZMOD 5] := Dvd.dvd.modEq_zero_int (Int.dvd_mul_right 5 y)
    have h6 : 20 * z ≡ 0 [ZMOD 5] := Dvd.dvd.modEq_zero_int (Dvd.dvd.mul_right (by decide) z)
    have h7 : 5 * y + 20 * z ≡ 0 [ZMOD 5] := Int.ModEq.add h5 h6
    have := h7.symm.trans h4
    tauto

/- 11. Let $a b c$ and $d$ be four distinct positive real numbers that satisfy the equations
$$
\left(a^{2012}-c^{2012}\right)\left(a^{2012}-d^{2012}\right)=2011
$$
and
$$
\left(b^{2012}-c^{2012}\right)\left(b^{2012}-d^{2012}\right)=2011
$$

Find the value of $(c d)^{2012}-(a b)^{2012}$. -/
theorem algebra_101308 {a b c d : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hdist : a ≠ b ∧ a ≠ c ∧ a ≠ d ∧ b ≠ c ∧ b ≠ d ∧ c ≠ d)
    (h1 : (a^2012 - c^2012) * (a^2012 - d^2012) = 2011) (h2 : (b^2012 - c^2012) * (b^2012 - d^2012) = 2011) :
    (c * d)^2012 - (a * b)^2012 = 2011 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_101308 {a b c d : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hdist : a ≠ b ∧ a ≠ c ∧ a ≠ d ∧ b ≠ c ∧ b ≠ d ∧ c ≠ d)
    (h1 : (a^2012 - c^2012) * (a^2012 - d^2012) = 2011) (h2 : (b^2012 - c^2012) * (b^2012 - d^2012) = 2011) :
    (c * d)^2012 - (a * b)^2012 = 2011 := by
  have a2012_ne_b2012 : a^2012 ≠ b^2012 := by
    by_contra h
    have : a = b := by
      have h1 : a^2012 = b^2012 := h
      have h2 : a > 0 := ha
      have h3 : b > 0 := hb
      rw [pow_left_inj (by linarith) (by linarith) (by norm_num)] at h1
      linarith
    tauto

  have h3 : (a^2012 - b^2012) * (a^2012 + b^2012 - (c^2012 + d^2012)) = 0 := by
    nlinarith [h1, h2, pow_pos ha 2012, pow_pos hb 2012, pow_pos hc 2012, pow_pos hd 2012]

  cases' (mul_eq_zero.mp h3) with h4 h5
  · -- a^2012 - b^2012 = 0, which contradicts a ≠ b
    exfalso
    have : a^2012 = b^2012 := by linarith
    have : a = b := by
      have h1 : a^2012 = b^2012 := this
      have h2 : a > 0 := ha
      have h3 : b > 0 := hb
      rw [pow_left_inj (by linarith) (by linarith) (by norm_num)] at h1
      linarith
    tauto
  · -- a^2012 + b^2012 = c^2012 + d^2012
    have h5' : a^2012 + b^2012 = c^2012 + d^2012 := by linarith
    nlinarith [h1, h2, h5', pow_pos ha 2012, pow_pos hb 2012, pow_pos hc 2012, pow_pos hd 2012, mul_pos ha hb, mul_pos hc hd, mul_pos ha hc, mul_pos ha hd, mul_pos hb hc, mul_pos hb hd]
  all_goals
    nlinarith

/- 3.049. $\left(\frac{\sqrt{\tan \alpha}+\sqrt{\cot \alpha}}{\sin \alpha+\cos \alpha}\right)^{2}=\frac{2}{\sin 2 \alpha}$. -/
theorem algebra_185489 (α : ℝ) (hα : α ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2)) :
    ((Real.sqrt (Real.tan α) + Real.sqrt (1 / Real.tan α)) / (Real.sin α + Real.cos α))^2 =
    2 / Real.sin (2 * α) := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_185489 (α : ℝ) (hα : α ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2)) :
    ((Real.sqrt (Real.tan α) + Real.sqrt (1 / Real.tan α)) / (Real.sin α + Real.cos α))^2 =
    2 / Real.sin (2 * α) := by
  rcases hα with ⟨h1, h2⟩
  have h3 : 0 < Real.sin α := by
    apply Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
    linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have h4 : 0 < Real.cos α := by
    have h5 : α < Real.pi / 2 := h2
    have h6 : Real.cos α > 0 := by
      apply Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo
      constructor
      linarith [Real.pi_pos]
      linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    linarith
  have htan : Real.tan α = Real.sin α / Real.cos α := by
    rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
  have h5 : Real.sqrt (Real.tan α) = Real.sqrt (Real.sin α) / Real.sqrt (Real.cos α) := by
    rw [htan]
    have h7 : 0 < Real.cos α := h4
    field_simp [Real.sqrt_div]
    all_goals
      try linarith
      try positivity
  have htan_pos : 0 < Real.tan α := by
    rw [htan]
    apply div_pos
    · linarith
    · linarith
  have h7 : 0 < (1 / Real.tan α : ℝ) := by
    positivity
  have h6 : Real.sqrt (1 / Real.tan α) = Real.sqrt (Real.cos α) / Real.sqrt (Real.sin α) := by
    have htan_eq : Real.tan α = Real.sin α / Real.cos α := by
      rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
    have htan_pos' : Real.tan α > 0 := htan_pos
    have h11 : 1 / Real.tan α = Real.cos α / Real.sin α := by
      rw [htan_eq]
      field_simp [h3.ne.symm]
      <;> linarith
    rw [h11]
    have h9 : 0 < Real.sin α := h3
    have h10 : 0 < Real.cos α := h4
    have h11 : Real.sqrt (Real.cos α / Real.sin α) = Real.sqrt (Real.cos α) / Real.sqrt (Real.sin α) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_div (by linarith)]
      all_goals positivity
    rw [h11]
    all_goals positivity
  have h12 : Real.sqrt (Real.tan α) + Real.sqrt (1 / Real.tan α) = (Real.sin α + Real.cos α) / (Real.sqrt (Real.sin α) * Real.sqrt (Real.cos α)) := by
    rw [h5, h6]

    have h9 : 0 < Real.sqrt (Real.sin α) := by positivity
    have h10 : 0 < Real.sqrt (Real.cos α) := by positivity

    have h14 : Real.sin α + Real.cos α > 0 := by positivity
    field_simp [h14, show Real.sqrt (Real.sin α) * Real.sqrt (Real.cos α) > 0 by positivity]

theorem algebra_1611 (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 1 ∧ x ≠ -1) (h : x / (|x| - 1) = 1) :

  have hx2 : x ≠ -1 := hx.2

      rw [show |x| = 1 / 2 by linarith [h7], show x = -1 / 2 by linarith [h6]]
      norm_num

theorem inequalities_282804 (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (a^n + b^n) / 2 ≥ ((a + b) / 2)^n := by

      intro n

        norm_num
      | succ n ih =>
        have h3 : (a ^ (n + 1) + b ^ (n + 1)) / 2 ≥ ((a + b) / 2) ^ (n + 1 : ℕ) := by
          have h4 : (a ^ (n + 1) + b ^ (n + 1)) / 2 ≥ ((a ^ n + b ^ n) / 2) * ((a + b) / 2) := by
            have h5 : (a ^ (n + 1) + b ^ (n + 1)) ≥ (a ^ n + b ^ n) * ((a + b) / 2) := by
              have h8 : 2 * (a ^ (n + 1) + b ^ (n + 1)) ≥ (a ^ n + b ^ n) * (a + b) := by
                have h9 : 2 * (a ^ (n + 1) + b ^ (n + 1)) - (a ^ n + b ^ n) * (a + b) ≥ 0 := by
                  have h10 : 2 * (a ^ (n + 1) + b ^ (n + 1)) - (a ^ n + b ^ n) * (a + b) = (a - b) * (a ^ n - b ^ n) := by
                    ring_nf
                  rw [h10]
                  have h12 : (a - b) * (a ^ n - b ^ n) ≥ 0 := by
                    by_cases h' : a ≥ b
                    · 
                      have h13 : a - b ≥ 0 := by linarith
                      have h14 : a ^ n ≥ b ^ n := by
                        apply pow_le_pow_left
                        all_goals
                          try linarith
                      have h15 : a ^ n - b ^ n ≥ 0 := by linarith
                      nlinarith
                    · 
                      have h16 : b ≥ a := by linarith
                      have h17 : a - b ≤ 0 := by linarith
                      have h18 : a ^ n ≤ b ^ n := by
                        apply pow_le_pow_left
                        all_goals
                          try linarith
                      have h19 : a ^ n - b ^ n ≤ 0 := by linarith
                      nlinarith
                  linarith
                nlinarith
              have h11 : (a ^ (n + 1) + b ^ (n + 1)) ≥ (a ^ n + b ^ n) * ((a + b) / 2) := by
                linarith
              linarith
            nlinarith
          have h7 : ((a ^ n + b ^ n) / 2) * ((a + b) / 2) ≥ ((a + b) / 2) ^ (n + 1 : ℕ) := by

theorem algebra_322665 {a b c : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (x₁ x₂ : ℝ)
    (h₁ : a * x₁^2 + b * x₁ + c = 0) (h₂ : a * x₂^2 + b * x₂ + c = 0)
    (s₁ s₂ s₃ : ℝ) (hs₁ : s₁ = x₁ + x₂) (hs₂ : s₂ = x₁^2 + x₂^2)
    (hs₃ : s₃ = x₁^3 + x₂^3) :
    a * s₃ + b * s₂ + c * s₁ = 0 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_322665 {a b c : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (x₁ x₂ : ℝ)
    (h₁ : a * x₁^2 + b * x₁ + c = 0) (h₂ : a * x₂^2 + b * x₂ + c = 0)
    (s₁ s₂ s₃ : ℝ) (hs₁ : s₁ = x₁ + x₂) (hs₂ : s₂ = x₁^2 + x₂^2)
    (hs₃ : s₃ = x₁^3 + x₂^3) :
    a * s₃ + b * s₂ + c * s₁ = 0 := by
  rw [hs₁, hs₂, hs₃]
  have eq₁ : a * x₁^3 + b * x₁^2 + c * x₁ = 0 := by
    have eq₁ : a * x₁^2 + b * x₁ + c = 0 := h₁
    -- Multiply by x₁
    calc
      a * x₁^3 + b * x₁^2 + c * x₁ = x₁ * (a * x₁^2 + b * x₁ + c) := by ring_nf
      _ = x₁ * 0 := by rw [eq₁]
      _ = 0 := by simp
  have eq₂ : a * x₂^3 + b * x₂^2 + c * x₂ = 0 := by
    have eq₂ : a * x₂^2 + b * x₂ + c = 0 := h₂
    -- Multiply by x₂
    calc
      a * x₂^3 + b * x₂^2 + c * x₂ = x₂ * (a * x₂^2 + b * x₂ + c) := by ring_nf
      _ = x₂ * 0 := by rw [eq₂]
      _ = 0 := by simp
  -- Now sum eq₁ and eq₂
  have eq₃ : a * (x₁^3 + x₂^3) + b * (x₁^2 + x₂^2) + c * (x₁ + x₂) = 0 := by
    linarith [eq₁, eq₂]
  -- The statement is precisely eq₃
  linarith [eq₃]

theorem algebra_18612 : {a : ℝ | ∃ x, x^2 + a = a * x} = Set.Iic 0 ∪ Set.Ici 4 := by

theorem number_theory_61295 (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ (5 ^ n) % 10 ^ (Nat.digits 10 (5 ^ m)).length = 5 ^ m := by
formal_proof:

theorem number_theory_61295 (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ (5 ^ n) % 10 ^ (Nat.digits 10 (5 ^ m)).length = 5 ^ m := by 
  use m 
  constructor 
  · -- Show that n is positive 
    exact hm
  · -- Show that $5^n \% 10^{k} = 5^m$ where k is the number of digits in $5^m$
    have h1 : (5 ^ m) % 10 ^ (Nat.digits 10 (5 ^ m)).length = 5 ^ m := by 
      have h2 : 5 ^ m < 10 ^ (Nat.digits 10 (5 ^ m)).length := by 
        -- Show that $5^m < 10^l$ where $l$ is length of digits of $5^m$ in base 10
        have h3 : (Nat.digits 10 (5 ^ m)).length = Nat.log 10 (5 ^ m) + 1 := by 
          rw [Nat.digits_len]
          all_goals 
            -- Show positivity and the base is valid
            have h5_pos : 5 ^ m > 0 := by 
              apply Nat.pow_pos 
              norm_num 
            have h10_pos : (10 : ℕ) > 1 := by norm_num
            -- Prove by properties of Nat.digits and Nat.log 
            all_goals 
              have h5_ge_1 : (5 : ℕ) ^ m ≥ 1 := by 
                have h1_pos : m > 0 := hm
                have h5_pos' : (5 : ℕ) ^ m > 0 := by 
                  apply Nat.pow_pos 
                  norm_num 
                have h5_ge_1 : (5 : ℕ) ^ m ≥ 1 := by 
                  apply Nat.one_le_pow 
                  norm_num 
                  all_goals linarith [hm] 
                linarith [h5_pos'] 
              nlinarith 
        rw [h3] 
        -- Need to show inequality using logarithm 
        -- Show 5^m < 10^(Nat.log 10 (5^m) + 1)
        have h3' : 5 ^ m < 10 ^ (Nat.log 10 (5 ^ m) + 1) := by 
          have h8 : Nat.log 10 (5 ^ m) = Nat.log 10 (5 ^ m) := rfl 
          -- Use natural logarithm properties 
          -- Note this is essentially using the definition of logarithm
          have h9 : 5 ^ m < 10 ^ (Nat.log 10 (5 ^ m) + 1) := by 
            have h5_pos : 5 ^ m > 0 := by 
              apply Nat.pow_pos 
              norm_num 
            have h5_ge_1 : (5 : ℕ) ^ m ≥ 1 := by 
              have h1_pos : m > 0 := hm
              have h5_pos' : (5 : ℕ) ^ m > 0 := by 
                apply Nat.pow_pos 
                norm_num 
              have h5_ge_1 : (5 : ℕ) ^ m ≥ 1 := by 
                apply Nat.one_le_pow 
                norm_num 
                all_goals linarith [hm] 
              linarith [h5_pos'] 
            have h5_lt : (5 : ℕ) ^ m < 10 ^ (Nat.log 10 (5 ^ m) + 1) := by 
              have h6 : Nat.log 10 (5 ^ m) = Nat.log 10 (5 ^ m) := rfl 
              apply Nat.lt_pow_of_log_lt 
              all_goals 
                -- Use inner positivity of 5^m
                have h5_pos' : 5 ^ m > 0 := by 
                  apply Nat.pow_pos 
                  norm_num 
                have h5_pos'' : (5 : ℕ) ^ m > 0 := by 
                  nlinarith [show 5 ^ m > 0 by apply Nat.pow_pos; norm_num] 
                -- Continue with property applications
                all_goals 
                  nlinarith 
            linarith [h5_lt] 
          linarith 
        linarith 
      apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt 
      linarith 
    exact_mod_cast h1

theorem algebra_5575
  (a b c : ℝ)
  (ha : a ≥ 0)
  (hb : b ≥ 1)
  (hc : c ≥ -1)
  (h : a + 4 * b + c + 3 = 2 * √a + 4 * √(b - 1) + 4 * √(c + 1)) :

formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_5575
  (a b c : ℝ)
  (ha : a ≥ 0)
  (hb : b ≥ 1)
  (hc : c ≥ -1)
  (h : a + 4 * b + c + 3 = 2 * √a + 4 * √(b - 1) + 4 * √(c + 1)) :
  a + b + c = 5.25 := by

  have h1 : (√a) ^ 2 = a := by
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
    linarith
  have h2 : (√(b - 1)) ^ 2 = b - 1 := by
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
    linarith
  have h3 : (√(c + 1)) ^ 2 = c + 1 := by
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
    linarith
  have h4 : (Real.sqrt a - 1) ^ 2 + 4 * (Real.sqrt (b - 1) - 0.5) ^ 2 + (Real.sqrt (c + 1) - 2) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt a - 1), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (b - 1) - 0.5), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (c + 1) - 2),
      Real.sqrt_nonneg a, Real.sqrt_nonneg (b - 1), Real.sqrt_nonneg (c + 1), 
      h1, h2, h3, h, 
      mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg a) (Real.sqrt_nonneg (b - 1)), 
      mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg a) (Real.sqrt_nonneg (c + 1)), 
      mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg (b - 1)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg (c + 1))]
  have h5 : Real.sqrt a - 1 = 0 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt a - 1), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (b - 1) - 0.5), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (c + 1) - 2),
      Real.sqrt_nonneg a, Real.sqrt_nonneg (b - 1), Real.sqrt_nonneg (c + 1)]
  have h6 : Real.sqrt (b - 1) - 0.5 = 0 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt a - 1), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (b - 1) - 0.5), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (c + 1) - 2),
      Real.sqrt_nonneg a, Real.sqrt_nonneg (b - 1), Real.sqrt_nonneg (c + 1)]
  have h7 : Real.sqrt (c + 1) - 2 = 0 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt a - 1), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (b - 1) - 0.5), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (c + 1) - 2),
      Real.sqrt_nonneg a, Real.sqrt_nonneg (b - 1), Real.sqrt_nonneg (c + 1)]
  have ha' : a = 1 := by
    have h8 : Real.sqrt a = 1 := by
      nlinarith [h5, Real.sqrt_nonneg a]
    have h9 : Real.sqrt a ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg a
    calc
      a = (Real.sqrt a) ^ 2 := by
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
        all_goals linarith
      _ = (1) ^ 2 := by 
        rw [h8]
      _ = (1 : ℝ) := by norm_num
  have hb'' : b = 1.25 := by
    have h8 : Real.sqrt (b - 1) = 0.5 := by
      nlinarith [h6, Real.sqrt_nonneg (b - 1)]
    have h9 : Real.sqrt (b - 1) ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (b - 1)
    have hb' : b - 1 = (0.5 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      calc

          rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
          linarith
        _ = (0.5) ^ 2 := by 
          rw [h8]
          all_goals nlinarith

  have hc'' : c = 3 := by
    have h9 : Real.sqrt (c + 1) = 2 := by
      nlinarith [h7, Real.sqrt_nonneg (c + 1)]
    have hc' : c + 1 = 4 := by 
      calc
        c + 1 = (Real.sqrt (c + 1)) ^ 2 := by 
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
          linarith
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by 
          rw [h9]
          all_goals nlinarith
        _ = (4 : ℝ) := by norm_num
    linarith 
  rw [ha', hb'', hc'']
  all_goals norm_num
